A little about us

We make room for curiosity, care and community.

Our club brings psychology out of the textbook and into everyday life. Through conversations, workshops, hands-on activities and shared experiences, Mindful Tattva invites students to look inward, connect with others and grow with intention.

The inner lens

Every mind has more than one layer.

Mindful Tattva makes space for the questions beneath the surface: what we notice, what we carry and how connection changes the story.

slow down · look inward · stay curious
Notice what you feel. Curiosity opens a door. Connection changes the story. There is depth beneath the surface.
Ψmind in motion
More than a club

A place to learn, listen and leave a little more grounded.

Mindful Tattva is a student-led psychology club under the Department of Applied Social Science at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University. We explore psychology, mental wellbeing, relationships, identity, resilience and the everyday science of being human.

Our mission

Make psychology approachable.

To make psychology approachable, relevant and rooted in compassion through student-led conversations, workshops, peer learning and community initiatives.

Our vision

Empathy in action.

A campus community where curiosity about the mind becomes empathy in action.

What members experience

Find your people and your pace.

Members can participate in workshops, discussion circles, awareness initiatives, hands-on activities, peer learning and future collaborations organised by Mindful Tattva.

Every meaningful space begins with a first step.

The beginning

A small idea with a big heart

Mindful Tattva began with a belief that conversations about the mind can be thoughtful, accessible and deeply human.

Our why

Psychology beyond the classroom

We are building a student space where theory meets lived experience through workshops, peer conversations and shared expression.
